title: AI生成诗歌的人类相似度特征：零样本分类研究
summary: 该研究提出零样本检测流程，分析人类与AI诗歌的可区分性，提取关键属性以改进分类，减少训练需求，并增强现代检测管道。
summary_en: This study proposes a zero-shot detection pipeline to analyze the distinguishability of human and AI poetry, extract key attributes for accurate classification, reduce training needs, and strengthen modern detection pipelines.
